theorem launch (G : Gauge) (σ₀ A Z : ℝ) (hσ : 0 < σ₀) (hz : 0≤Z) :
    ∃ σ C : ℝ, 0 < σ ∧ σ≤σ₀ ∧ 0≤C ∧
     ∀ m : ℕ→Side, Tendsto (fun i => (m i).val) atTop atTop →
      ∀ (p : Clip) (B : Bed) (a b : ℝ), p.direct ≤ Z → B.roots.strip σ₀ A → (∀ i : Side, Floor B p i a b) →
        (∀ i, Bid.Sworn B (m i) G) → (∀ i, B.diagonal.acts (m i)=1) →
         ∃ Q : PathData G, Q.row=rowPath B ∧ Attached B Q ∧
          (∀ i, (Q.loop i).coeff=0) ∧ (∀ τ k Λ, 0<τ → τ≤σ → C≤k → rowPrice σ₀ A ≤ k → 0≤Λ → Q.Bounds p τ k Λ) ∧
          ∀ i j, j ≤ 4 → SameJet j (fun x => mainTerm p Q (represent (x:fieldDir G (m i) 1))) (fun x => Wilson.energy (represent x)) := by

verdicts.summary: [L] proves less than [M] prints. [M] prints `Gauge-annihilating mixed functionals satisfy $b_1\mathsf Gb_2=b_{1,\rm ax}\mathsf Q^{-1}b_{2,\rm ax}$.`.
evidence: `greyson` (Shape/Scaled.lean:363), `setWest` (VertexWeights.lean:357) and `exchangeYield` (Exchange.lean:407, (C′+3A′DA′)/24) state the momentum orders, the C₃, C₄ bounds and the D⁴S_stat bound. For the pairing, `radiant` (Joint/FourPoint.lean:202) gives ⟨Hu,v⟩ = ⟨Hu,N^{−1}Hv⟩, and `triumph4` (FourPoint.lean:289), which the claim omits, uses it with the completed inverse commonM^{−1}. No declaration has the axial Hessian inverse in b₁𝖦b₂ = b_{1,ax}𝖰^{−1}b_{2,ax}.

`Stationary.radiant` (Next/STATIONARY/Joint/FourPoint.lean:202) states ⟨Hu, v⟩ = ⟨Hu, N⁻¹Hv⟩. It has no axial restriction and no Q⁻¹, and the other `radiant` declarations (Deck/Rove.lean, Glints.lean, etc.) are unrelated. `greyson`, `setWest` and `exchangeYield` state the momentum orders, the C₃, C₄ bounds and the quartic bound, as the claim says.
